title: Kinetic model, assay design and parameter identifiability for fluorogenic haloalkane dehalogenase assays
description:
Mass-action model of a fluorogenic haloalkane dehalogenase assay including the covalent alkyl-enzyme intermediate, a dead-end inhibitory complex and spontaneous hydrolysis, together with the numerical analyses reported in the Supporting Information of Mion et al.

The code reproduces: the validity check of the quasi-steady-state reduction against the full mass-action system; the relation between the fitted steady-state constants and the elementary rate constants; the substrate-depletion calculation for the initial-rate window; and simulation-based practical identifiability of the fitted parameters under the concentration design used, including the proposed reparametrisation. The computations use reported aggregate parameters and synthetic perturbations rather than raw experimental observations.

Running run_all.py regenerates every table and the figure of that section.
